registry_contract.dependencies: G1-EXP-TENSOR-GPU-103, G1-EXP-TENSOR-GPU-105, G1-EXP-TENSOR-GPU-106, G1-EXP-TENSOR-GPU-109, ReferenceCompileResult, Gate-1 ignition receipt, Fourfold evidence packet, CompiledRelationBlocks

title: Retain stateless Forest and relation membership verification after existing-receipt authority audit

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Audit the existing revision-bound result and receipt surfaces at the natural Gate-1 before/after owner before considering any shortcut around compile_relation_blocks Forest-integrity or retained-relation membership verification. Determine whether an already-authoritative contract carries both the exact supplied Forest identity and a verified relation-digest-to-ForestEdge association. Prefer retaining existing checks over minting a trusted caller parameter, persistent index, cache or second receipt family.

reference_compile_result.finding: ReferenceCompileResult naturally co-locates the KnowledgeForest and FourfoldSnapshot plus source identities, but it is a plain frozen result record rather than a canonical verification receipt. It has no __post_init__ pairing check and no retained digest-to-edge association. The focused contract constructs a mismatched Forest/snapshot result successfully and proves the unchanged relation compiler still refuses it at the independent source_forest_sha256 check.

gate1_ignition_receipt.finding: The existing fourfold receipt block records base/candidate source-bundle digests, base/candidate snapshot digests and the IgnitionGraphDelta. It does not record an authoritative Forest object/artifact or a relation-digest-to-edge association. GPU-104 already proved the graph delta does not encode same-plane relation changes.

fourfold_evidence_packet.finding: Fourfold evidence correctly binds candidate artifact identity, source revision, exact snapshot digest and snapshot.source_forest_sha256, and stores exact snapshot bytes. It does not store the supplied KnowledgeForest bytes/object and does not carry a digest-to-ForestEdge association. It proves candidate/snapshot/Forest-digest provenance, not which concrete Forest edge corresponds to each retained relation digest without examining the Forest.

compiled_relation_blocks_receipt.finding: CompiledRelationBlocks binds source_forest_sha256 and its ProjectionSubject binds the exact Fourfold snapshot digest, but this receipt exists only after compile_relation_blocks has completed the checks under audit. Reusing its own output as pre-compilation trust would be circular and cannot remove first-pass verification.

focused_contract.behavior: A caller can construct ReferenceCompileResult with a Forest whose content digest no longer matches the retained Fourfold snapshot. The result record accepts the pair, while compile_relation_blocks fails closed with 'snapshot does not bind the supplied Forest digest'.
focused_contract.reason: This pins the exact trust boundary that would be violated by treating ReferenceCompileResult as a pre-verified receipt merely because Gate 1 naturally owns both before/after compile results.

finding.summary: No existing revision-bound result/receipt simultaneously proves the supplied Forest object and carries an authoritative retained relation digest-to-ForestEdge association. ReferenceCompileResult is natural ownership, not trust authority; Gate-1 receipts and Fourfold evidence bind revision/snapshot identities but not the missing mapping; CompiledRelationBlocks is downstream output. GPU-110 therefore retains both current stateless verification passes and closes without production changes.

decision.summary: Do not optimize the measured relation-hash seam by weakening authority. Move the Gardener search to the next measured compiler bucket instead.

unsafe_shortcuts_rejected: treat any ReferenceCompileResult instance as proof that its Forest and snapshot still match
treat the Gate-1 graph delta as a same-plane relation delta receipt
treat a Fourfold evidence item's source_forest_sha256 as a digest-to-edge map
feed a prior CompiledRelationBlocks receipt back as trusted pre-compilation authority
add a Tensor-owned persistent digest-to-edge index
add a caller-supplied trusted Forest digest that skips recomputing the supplied object

verification.kind: focused trust-boundary contract plus exact-code audit of existing revision-bound result/receipt surfaces
verification.focused_contract_note: Hosted Actions for the new focused head were not yet visible when this packet was first written; no green claim is made until a matching run is observed.

gardener_result.base_to_contract_diff: 1 test file; +32/-0 before the work-packet closure record

claim_boundaries: GPU-110 is an authority audit and focused fail-closed contract, not a latency or memory benchmark.
GPU-102 timing remains diagnostic attribution only; no speedup is inferred from retaining or removing any pass.
No production incremental Tensor path exists as a result of GPU-110.
No Tensor-vs-Forest, GPU/Tensor-Core, CrewAI or AlphaEvolve superiority claim.
No OwnerApproval, PromotionReceipt, merge, Ready-for-Review or Gate transition.
next_bounded_step: GPU-111 should move to the next measured, authority-neutral compiler bucket: explicit selected-signature handling. Audit whether the existing requested RelationSignature objects can be reused directly by tuple key so selected-mode edges do not construct a fresh RelationSignature per Forest edge. Preserve discover-all semantics, avoid a persistent cache or new abstraction, and measure the existing GPU-100/102 probe before claiming any benefit.
